name: Big Linda
notes: The source provides a named base and explicit encounter changes.

statBlock.name: Big Linda
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4. Immune to acid. Blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 14. No languages.
statBlock.description: The Queen of Thieves brings her arena champion out of its den with a whistle.

sections.Base stat block: Tyrannosaurus Rex, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). The arena encounter adds Acid Spew, acid immunity, blindsight, and the Queen’s charm. Use the adventure’s CR 9.
sections.Traits: The Queen’s Charm. Big Linda is permanently Charmed by the Queen of Thieves and generally obeys her spoken commands.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack against different targets.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 17) and Restrained until the grapple ends. Big Linda cannot Bite a different target during that grapple.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Acid Spew (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Dexterity save against 49 (11d8) acid damage, halved on success.

name: Cavalier

statBlock.name: Cavalier

sections.Traits:

Light’s Fury. Add 9 (2d8) radiant damage to a weapon hit, already included below.
Skilled Rider. While mounted, the cavalier can make an attack targeting its mount target the cavalier instead.
sections.Spellcasting:
8th-level paladin spellcasting. Charisma, save DC 13, +5 to hit.
1st level (4 slots). Bless, Command, Cure Wounds.
2nd level (3 slots). Branding Smite, Find Steed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Lance. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Disadvantage within 5 ft. Hit 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing and 9 (2d8) radiant damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing and 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

sections.Spellcasting:
9th-level cleric spellcasting. Wisdom, printed save DC 12, printed +4 to hit.

ruleNotes: The printing explicitly lists spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spells, and +3 to hit with the spear. The profile retains those values.

statBlock.name: Eoghan Ghostweaver
statBlock.otherStatistics: Intelligence +6 and Wisdom +9 saves. Medicine +9, Nature +6, Survival +9, Perception +9. Resists damage from spells. Passive Perception 19. Elven and Druidic.
statBlock.description: An elven priest who tends the Shrine of Morrigan with three treants and offers resurrection at a price.

sections.Printed source: Shrine of Morrigan, p. 105. Purge Contamination, Appendix D, p. 229.
sections.Base stat block: Archmage, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Use the adventure’s Intelligence, Wisdom, trained skills, languages, and druid spell list. The new list drops the base defenses that depended on Mage Armor and Stoneskin.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
18th-level druid spellcasting. Wisdom, save DC 17, +9 to hit before the staff’s bonus.
At will. Druidcraft, Mending, Poison Spray, Produce Flame.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Entangle, Faerie Fire, Speak with Animals.
2nd level (3 slots). Animal Messenger, Beast Sense, Hold Person.
3rd level (3 slots). Conjure Animals, Purge Contamination, Sleet Storm.
4th level (3 slots). Ice Storm, Polymorph, Wall of Fire.
5th level (3 slots). Commune with Nature, Cone of Cold, Greater Restoration.
6th level (1 slot). Conjure Fey, Heal.
7th level (1 slot). Resurrection.
8th level (1 slot). Feeblemind.
9th level (1 slot). Foresight.
sections.Setting spell: Purge Contamination (3rd level). Cast for 1 hour and touch one contaminated humanoid. Consume 100 gp of alchemical fluids or holy water. Remove every contamination level and mutation, then give the target one level of Exhaustion for each level removed.
sections.Actions:
Staff of the Woodlands. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) when wielded in two hands.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Staff of the Woodlands:
While holding the staff, add +2 to spell attack rolls. The staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 per dawn. If the last charge is spent, the staff becomes mundane on a roll of 1 on a d20.
One action, using Eoghan’s spell save DC. Animal Friendship (1), Awaken (5), Barkskin (2), Locate Animals or Plants (2), Speak with Animals (1), Speak with Plants (3), or Wall of Thorns (6). Pass without Trace costs no charge.
Tree Form costs one charge and one action while planting the staff in fertile ground. It grows into a 60-ft. tree with a 5-ft.-diameter trunk and a 20-ft. branch radius. Touch the tree and speak its command word as an action to return it to staff form.
sections.Encounter notes: Three treants defend Eoghan if he is attacked. His Resurrection ritual requires a living humanoid sacrifice whose level or CR equals or exceeds the deceased’s, a diamond or delerium substitute, and a personal offering. If he uses delerium in place of the diamond, the revived creature gains a random Drakkenheim Madness.

ruleNotes: Recomputed the inherited save proficiencies and passive Perception from the adventure’s ability scores and training. Staff attack and charge rules follow SRD 5.1.

name: Lenore von Kessel
notes: The source provides a named base and explicit encounter changes.

statBlock.name: Lenore von Kessel
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Deception +5, Insight +4, Perception +4, Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common.
statBlock.description: The missing queen-consort lives in the gardens of Queen’s Park. She covers her face with a cracked porcelain mask.

sections.Base stat block: Medusa, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Queen’s Park replaces the inherited Petrifying Gaze and actions with Radiant Gaze and Tentacle Hair.
sections.Traits:
Radiant Gaze. When a creature that can see Lenore’s eyes starts its turn within 30 ft. of her, she can force a DC 14 Constitution save if she is not Incapacitated and can see it. Failure deals 22 (4d10) radiant damage and adds one contamination level. Success halves the damage.
Avert Eyes. Unless Surprised, a creature can look away at the start of its turn to avoid the save. It cannot see Lenore until its next turn starts, when it can avert its gaze again. If it looks at her early, it immediately saves against the gaze.
Own Reflection. If Lenore sees herself in a polished surface within 30 ft. while in bright light, she is Blinded and Incapacitated for 1d6 hours.
sections.Actions: Tentacle Hair. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing and 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save and gains one contamination level on failure.
sections.Encounter notes: Her attendants use Dryad statistics. Her own likeness and the names of her lost family provoke her.

ruleNotes: The encounter replaces the Medusa’s actions. Tentacle Hair is its only printed replacement.

name: Minazorond
pages: Castle Drakken, pp. 181, 183. Tower Dragon traits, Appendix A, p. 198. Seals and Crown, Appendix D, p. 233.
notes: The source provides a named base and explicit encounter changes.

statBlock.name: Minazorond
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Dexterity +7, Constitution +15, Wisdom +10, Charisma +12 saves. Insight +10, Perception +17, Stealth +7. Immune to lightning. Resists poison, psychic, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from attacks that are neither magical nor adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision and truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 27. Common and Draconic. He remains silent during the palace encounter.
statBlock.description: The ancient bronze guardian of Castle Drakken treats its mutated occupants as residents and humanoid visitors as intruders.

sections.Printed source: Castle Drakken, pp. 181, 183. Tower Dragon traits, Appendix A, p. 198. Seals and Crown, Appendix D, p. 233.
sections.Base stat block: Ancient Bronze Dragon, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Add the Tower Dragon’s guardian traits from Appendix A. The palace encounter adds the trigger distance, patrol limits, and response to a Seal of Drakkenheim. Use the ancient dragon’s CR 22.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Constructed Nature. Needs no food, air, drink, or sleep.
False Appearance. While still, he resembles an inanimate bronze statue.
Faultless Tracker. A creature that triggers his activation becomes his quarry. He knows where and how far away it is until it leaves Drakkenheim or he is destroyed.
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change his form.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Rejuvenation. After destruction, he returns to full HP in 1 hour unless Disintegrate is cast on his remains.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. May use Frightful Presence, then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Chosen creatures within 120 ft. who know he is there make a DC 20 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute. Repeat at the end of each turn. Once a creature succeeds or the effect ends, it is immune to this presence for 24 hours.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose Lightning Breath or Repulsion Breath.
Lightning Breath. Creatures in a 120-ft. line, 10 ft. wide, make a DC 23 Dexterity save against 88 (16d10) lightning damage, halved on success.
Repulsion Breath. Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 23 Strength save or are pushed 60 ft. away.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions. Recover all at the start of his turn and use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Detect. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack. Make one Tail attack.
Wing Attack (costs 2). Creatures within 15 ft. make a DC 24 Dexterity save or take 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage and fall Prone. He can then fly up to half his flying speed.
sections.Encounter notes: He attacks intruders who approach within 150 ft. of the palace. He cannot follow them inside and stops pursuit at the castle grounds. He ignores creatures attuned to a Seal of Drakkenheim unless they attack him or cast a spell on him, in which case he ignores that protection for 24 hours. An action presenting a seal within 30 ft. can rebuke him if he can see or hear the presenter and loses a contested Charisma check. He cannot move or take actions or reactions for 1 minute or until he takes damage. If he wins the check, he is immune to that creature’s rebuke for 24 hours. He obeys the wearer of the Crown of Westemär. Wish alone restores his sanity.

ruleNotes: The base dragon’s self-transformation is suppressed here because the adventure gives Minazorond Immutable Form.

name: Warp Witch
notes: The source provides a named base and explicit encounter changes.

statBlock.name: Warp Witch
statBlock.otherStatistics: Resists acid, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to cold, necrotic, and poison damage. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Any languages it knew in life.
statBlock.description: A ghost whose wail overwhelms nearby minds and whose possession can leave lasting mutations.

sections.Base stat block: Ghost, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Replace Horrifying Visage with Psychic Wail and add Mutate Host. The inherited Possession remains available.
sections.Traits:
Ethereal Sight. Can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or the reverse.
Incorporeal Movement. The witch passes through objects and creatures as difficult terrain. Ending its turn inside an object deals 5 (1d10) force damage to the witch.
sections.Actions:
Withering Touch. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Etherealness. Move between the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal. The witch remains visible from the other plane but cannot affect anything there or be affected by it.
Psychic Wail (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Intelligence save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage and makes the target Incapacitated until the end of the witch’s next turn.
Possession (recharge 6). One visible humanoid within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure the witch vanishes and controls the target’s body. The target stays aware, is Incapacitated, and cannot control its body. The witch keeps its own alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and Charmed and Frightened immunities. It otherwise uses the target’s statistics without its knowledge, proficiencies, or class features. Only effects that turn Undead can target it during possession. The effect also ends if the body falls to 0 HP, the witch ends it as a bonus action, or it is turned or expelled by a spell such as Dispel Evil and Good. On ending, the witch appears in a vacant space within 5 ft. A humanoid that succeeds or is freed is immune to this witch’s Possession for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus Actions: Mutate Host. While possessing a creature, force it to make a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure it gains one contamination level and automatically acquires a random mutation in place of the normal mutation check.
